raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions has 27 txn_ids that appear twice, once as record_version 1 and once as a record_version 2 correction, which the 2026-01-18 payments-source note confirms. Keeping only the highest record_version per txn_id before applying the POSTED filter gives one correct row per transaction, including cases where the correction is REVERSED.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.82, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC) = 1) latest WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
